caption: Eating a dozen extra hot wings:
title: Eating a dozen extra hot wings 🔥

through_line.name: the wing
through_line.prop_prompt: a single chicken wing coated in thick glossy orange sauce, sauce pooling and dripping off the end, a small paper cup of white dressing beside it
progression: an orange glow coming down the tube
the first wing sliding through, dripping
the wing lands and announces itself
the cavity walls have gone orange
the eleventh wing goes past the mouth
everything is still orange and slowly cooling

blocks.through_line_state: an orange glow coming down the tube
blocks.sfx: a distant sizzle, a wet slide, a swallow
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: an orange glow washing over Pipes from above
CLOSE, low angle: Gut squinting up into the orange light
MEDIUM, high angle: the first wing sliding into view, dripping
CLOSE on the eyes: orange reflecting in Gut's pupils

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Gut. It's coming in orange.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: How orange are we talking?

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Wings. Extra hot. Twelve of them.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Twelve? She ordered a dozen wings?

blocks.through_line_state: the first wing sliding through, dripping
blocks.sfx: a wet slide, a drip, a strained groan
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Gut bellowing upward
MEDIUM, eye level: Pipes ducking sauce that is coming down anyway
MEDIUM, high angle: the tube walls streaked orange
CLOSE on Pipes' eyes watering from the fumes

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Absolutely not. Turn them around.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: There's ranch. Does ranch help?

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Ranch does not fix extra hot.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: She's dipping. She's dipping right now.

blocks.through_line_state: the wing lands and announces itself
blocks.sfx: a hot splash, a rising hiss, a confident whoop
shots: MEDIUM, high angle: the wing landing and the liquid around it going orange
CLOSE, low angle: two bold eyes opening on the glossy sauce
MEDIUM, eye level: Gut backing away from the heat
CLOSE on the eyes: the wing thrilled, Gut steaming faintly

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: You are glowing. That's genuinely new.

turns.speaker: wing
turns.line: Extra hot, baby! Feel that heat!

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: I feel it. Everyone feels it.

turns.speaker: wing
turns.line: Eleven more of us are coming!

blocks.through_line_state: the cavity walls have gone orange
blocks.sfx: a phone tap, a low alarm tone, a hum
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: HQ reading the phone, faintly sweating
CLOSE, low angle: the veined wall behind HQ glowing warm
MEDIUM, high angle: HQ waving one small arm dismissively
CLOSE on HQ's eyes narrowing at the screen

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: HQ, my walls are on fire.

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: That's capsaicin. It's not real fire.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: It feels extremely real down here.

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: She's ordering a milk. That helps.

blocks.through_line_state: the eleventh wing goes past the mouth
blocks.sfx: a swinging creak, a smug hum, a wet pass
shots: MEDIUM, high angle: the mouth interior, teeth framing the light
CLOSE, low angle: Yuvi swinging lazily into frame
MEDIUM, eye level: a wing sailing past behind Yuvi, unremarked
CLOSE on the eyes: Yuvi winking, entirely comfortable

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Yuvi, tell her to stop eating.

turns.speaker: yuvi
turns.line: She can't hear me. Nobody can.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Then why are you always talking?

turns.speaker: yuvi
turns.line: Because I'm charming. Also, sauce number nine.

blocks.through_line_state: everything is still orange and slowly cooling
blocks.sfx: a settling hiss, one low rumble, silence
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: the tunnel walls faintly orange in the amber light
CLOSE, low angle: Gut cooling down, relieved
MEDIUM, high angle: Rusty's eyes opening slowly behind him
CLOSE on the eyes: Gut's relief ending

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: It's finally cooling off. We survived that.

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: I have some news for you.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Don't. Don't say it, Rusty.

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: It comes back around.
